reason: Initial relative Extra Trees improves precision but leaves sustained false alerts. Compare record-relative scale definitions and a regularized boosted classifier. Selection criteria remain unchanged.
relative_noise_scale: Maximum of initial-reference scaled MAD, IQR/1.349, and 0.05 times the global training robust scale.
relative_fraction_scale: Maximum of the absolute initial-reference median and the global training robust scale.
scope: Additional development comparisons informed by the first validation run, not a new holdout.
